::: {#def-simulation-estimate}
#### Simulation estimate

A **simulation estimate** of the [expectation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation) $\E{T}$ of an [estimate](estimation.qmd#def-estimate) $T$
is the [average](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-vectors.html#def-mean) of the [replications](#def-replication)' [estimates](estimation.qmd#def-estimate) $T_1, \ldots, T_M$:

$$\samplemean{T}{M} \eqdef \avgto{m}{M} T_m.$$
:::
